replay_crash_dump: run repro_crash.py with a crash dump JSON to replay a Diplomacy game phase
replay_crash_with_orders: run repro_crash.py with a crash dump and orders JSON file to replay specific orders
replay_crash_with_phase: run repro_crash.py with a crash dump and --phase flag to replay a specific phase like F1905M
rollback_and_process_game: use pydipcc.Game.rolled_back_to_phase_start to rollback a game then call process to advance
set_orders_and_process: use game.set_orders to assign orders per power then call game.process to resolve the phase
